coverage.logs: Covered by docs/newrelic-log-policy.json redaction, drop rules, required fields, excluded fields, and ingest estimates.
coverage.apm_attributes: Only route group, environment, deployment version, request id, trace id, workflow name, status class, and bounded feature/workflow names are allowed.
coverage.custom_events: Only low-cardinality event names, durations, success flags, failure classes, queue depth, backlog age, and bounded owner/workflow labels are allowed.
coverage.query_attributes: Use query id, statement type, database, schema, wait category, and plan operation; avoid raw SQL text in shared dashboards.
coverage.synthetics: Use public endpoints, response shape, status code, timing, TLS, redirect behavior, and synthetic monitor metadata; do not include production user data.

mitigations: Dashboard validation rejects secret-like terms in dashboard query raw configuration.
Log policy excludes raw request/response bodies and credential-like fields.
Query dashboards facet by query id and statement type rather than raw SQL text.
Synthetic checks must use public endpoints or test-only flows.
NerdGraph scripts fail closed when New Relic credentials are missing.
